description:
Generate stock-report PNG images and return their URLs, with the charts
    attached as PNG image content so the assistant can see them.

    The JSON (symbol, status, images with url/status, disclaimer) is the same
    with or without attachments; the image blocks are added after it.

    Args:
        symbol: Stock symbol, e.g. "RXRX".
        force: Regenerate images instead of using cached PNGs. Defaults to True
            so manually requested images reflect the latest available data.
        types: Optional subset of chart types. Allowed values are
            "ai_prediction", "iv_radar", "option_pressure", "monte_carlo",
            and "equity_curves". Omit to generate every chart type.
        attach_images: Attach each available chart as an image. Defaults to
            True; False returns the JSON with URLs only.
name: generate_stock_images
title: Stock Chart Generator
